summary: HUD text-row updater. Always renders a dual-text baseline via DualTextDisplay from three globals, then, when this[2] (offset 0x8) is non-null, formats a value string with sub_49C8F0 and a label string with sub_49C960 into a 64-byte stack buffer and renders both with StringFormatAndRender at a Y position offset from dword_5CCBBC + dword_5CCBB8. Returns the guard value when the render path is skipped.

operations.description: Load globals into locals: v1 = dword_5CCBB8, v3 = dword_7CE238, v4 = dword_5CCBC0.
Always render the dual-text baseline: DualTextDisplay(dword_5CCBC0, dword_7CE238, dword_5CCBB8).
Read this[2] (offset 0x8) into result; this value also serves as the render guard.
Guard on result (this[2], offset 0x8) being non-zero; the string render path runs only then.
Compute the Y position as v6 = dword_5CCBBC + dword_5CCBB8.
Render the value row: StringFormatAndRender(buffer, v4, v6, this[2], *(this[5] + 84), 1), reading the label source through this+0x14 (this[5]).
Render the label row and return its result: StringFormatAndRender(buffer, v3, v6, this[2], *(this[5] + 84), 0).
When the guard fails, return the stored result (this[2], which was zero).
